LanguageData.Gun_SW_Model_500_RWP.label: S&W Model 500
LanguageData.Gun_SW_Model_500_RWP.description: The S&W Model 500 is a powerful revolver designed for devastating impact at close to medium range. Known for its high stopping power, this handgun fires large-caliber rounds capable of penetrating body armor. However, its hefty recoil requires a skilled hand for accurate use. Ideal for those seeking uncompromised firepower in a handgun form.
